sentences.text: Elister L. `` Larry '' Wilmore -LRB- born October 30 , 1961 -RRB- is an American comedian , writer , producer , and actor .	comedian	comedian	writer	writer	actor	actor

Wilmore served as the `` Senior Black Correspondent '' on The Daily Show from 2006 to 2014 , and hosted The Nightly Show with Larry Wilmore from 2015 to 2016 .	The Daily Show	The Daily Show	The Nightly Show with Larry Wilmore	The Nightly Show with Larry Wilmore
He serves as an executive producer for the ABC television series Black-ish .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	Black-ish	Black-ish
He is also the co-creator , alongside Issa Rae , of the HBO television series Insecure .	Issa Rae	Issa Rae	HBO	HBO	Insecure	Insecure (TV series)
